properties.name: VIOLATES_RULE and COMPLIES_WITH read zero not because nobody bothered but because no path reaches DesignRule — the edge types name EnvironmentRule, of which this design has none
properties.statement:
MEASURED 2026-09-11 while exercising all 180 served tools. THIS SHARPENS THE DECISION IT HANGS ON, which asked whether the governance vocabulary is immature or is a distinction nothing reads. The measurement of 2026-08-30 recorded VIOLATES_RULE 0, COMPLIES_WITH 0, EnvironmentRule 0 and read them as UNUSED. They are not merely unused: for the rule type this design actually has, they are UNREACHABLE.

⭐ ALL THREE TOOLS RESOLVE `rule_id` TO AN EnvironmentRule. Probed against a real rule:
    violates_rule{element_id: "cmp:service", rule_id: "rule:success-is-read-from-the-authoritative-object"}
    → "Node not found: EnvironmentRule rule:success-is-read-from-the-authoritative-object"
Same for `complies_with`, and `set_violation_status` refuses on the same type.

🛑 AND IT IS NOT ONLY THE TYPED TOOLS — the generic escape hatch is closed too. `create_edge` refuses at the schema level: *"Invalid edge: VIOLATES_RULE cannot connect Component to DesignRule. No edge type names both Component and DesignRule."* So there is NO served path, typed or generic.

COUNTS TODAY (the 2026-08-30 figures have grown): **DesignRule 27** (was 21), **EnvironmentRule 0**, **Constraint 7** (was 4), VIOLATES_RULE **0**, COMPLIES_WITH **0**.

The 27 include `rule:success-is-read-from-the-authoritative-object`, `rule:design-intent-moves-only-on-the-owners-word` and `rule:an-issue-is-root-caused-then-pinned-by-a-test-then-fixed` — the rules this project governs itself by. Nothing served can record that a component violated one, or complied with one.

⭐ WHY THIS MATTERS TO THE OPEN QUESTION IT HANGS ON: `dec:bl-155` states outright that a usage count CANNOT TELL UNUSED FROM UNREACHABLE. For these two edge types the question is now settled in favour of unreachable, which removes them from the "is the vocabulary wrong?" column — a zero produced by a missing path is no evidence at all about whether the distinction earns its keep. The remaining zeroes (QualityGate, GATED_ON, IMPOSES) were not probed this way and this says nothing about them.

⚠️ ALSO: all three tools declare `rule_id` as a bare `{"type": "string"}` with NO DESCRIPTION AT ALL, so nothing on the served surface says which rule type is meant. An agent holding 27 DesignRules has no way to learn from the schema that they are the wrong kind.

🛑 WHAT THIS DOES NOT ESTABLISH. It does not say the binding to EnvironmentRule is WRONG — `chg:the-environment-compliance-layer-is-built-as-a-whole-leg` built that leg deliberately, and a compliance regime aimed at an operating environment may be exactly right. Nor has anyone asked whether a DesignRule OUGHT to be violable; `rule:the-self-host-always-trails-what-it-teaches` cuts against reading reflow2's own shape as the test. What is established is only that the path does not exist, that no schema text says so, and that the zeroes have a mechanical explanation nobody had recorded. No cause beyond that was investigated and the root-cause skill was not run.
